profileDesignDecisions.wholeGoalCoverageRationale: e1 covers material/release consequences for both primary and rechargeable examples; e2 separates collection/recovery and remaining impacts; e3 supplies bounded environmental discussion and transfer. This preserves both disposal and recycling rather than only primary-cell functioning.
profileDesignDecisions.sourceFaithfulnessRationale: HH operator remains the explicitly derived BNE operationalization; MV disposal/recycling component does not alone close rare-metal extraction. No additional national/course source coverage is inferred.

profileDesignDecisions.wholeGoalCoverageRationale: e1 anchors rare-metal supply to the stated electrochemical-source component; e2 connects extraction conditions to their material consequences; e3 requires argued, limited discussion. Rare and rare-earth are kept distinct without a mandatory taxonomy catalogue.
profileDesignDecisions.sourceFaithfulnessRationale: MV rare-metal-extraction duty only; no independent HH source entitlement, exhaustive metal list, industrial mechanism, full citation/source-criticism routine or complete quantitative LCA is granted.

profileDesignDecisions.wholeGoalCoverageRationale: e1 accounts for new-raw-material displacement; e2 requires common-boundary energy reasoning; e3 uses BOTH links for BOTH personal consumption and disposal. All facets are required rather than interchangeable alternatives.
profileDesignDecisions.sourceFaithfulnessRationale: NW SekI/first-stage field-4 linked significance/own behavior competence; no broad generic decision-framework or concrete process-mechanism entitlement.

completeCaseDesignDecisions.scientificAndSourceBoundedReason: Both primary Zn/Mn and lead-accumulator examples are explicitly assessed. The supplied electrolyte/lead releases support a controlled-route judgment; collection and metal recovery are distinct, and positive energy/residue impacts remain.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.independentTransferReason: At K*, complete metal recovery is a limiting condition; the learner must identify electrolyte/energy consequences that remain. The companion NiMH case supplies a chemically changed context beyond changing recovery numbers.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.rubricReason: All e1/e2/e3 have explanation-based full/partial/zero criteria. No score follows from merely naming a type or recognizing an image.

completeCaseDesignDecisions.scientificAndSourceBoundedReason: The NiMH versus primary-battery context and a new R-only critical residue require material-specific reasoning. The stated energy index compares collection, transport AND treatment for a fixed 100-device group of each same-composition type; it must not be reinterpreted as plant-treatment energy alone.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.independentTransferReason: The R-specific release is a meaningful changed condition, while P stays unchanged. A correct response must integrate this observation and missing residue/impact data; it may confirm an initial B choice.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.rubricReason: Data, model answer and explanation rubrics are scientifically usable. The task and exact joined profile briefs must first stop requiring a changed judgment when confirmation is justified.

completeCaseDesignDecisions.scientificAndSourceBoundedReason: Equal useful M output and equal extraction yield make the lower 0.05% grade require more ore than 0.5% (tenfold under that model). The supplied soluble M-bearing release has a stated ecological consequence; controlling water changes that facet without erasing ore demand.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.independentTransferReason: The water-control improvement changes a chemical/environmental condition. Arguments must distinguish the corrected release from unchanged ore grade and missing energy/transport data.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.rubricReason: Rubric separately checks source-component/rarity context, ore/release explanation and bounded transfer. No metallurgical mechanism or real-mine claim is demanded.

completeCaseDesignDecisions.scientificAndSourceBoundedReason: By-product N remains a raw material for a distinct electrochemical-source constituent. Energy 10 only for separation and 40 including mining/treatment are not a common-boundary fourfold overall comparison; joint H/N extraction/allocation data are missing.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.independentTransferReason: New mining and untreated soluble N-bearing water invalidate reliance on the unchanged partial advertisement. This changes extraction/material conditions rather than only numbers.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.rubricReason: Full credit needs contextual supply, boundary/release reasoning and a limited A/B conclusion; automatic opposite rankings are rejected. Source criticism as a complete separate curricular routine is not added.

completeCaseDesignDecisions.scientificAndSourceBoundedReason: For the same usable 1 kg, 0.8 kg recovered plus 0.2 kg new metal preserves mass/accounting; energy 35 versus 100 is positive and lower within the common supplied boundary. Resource saving does not make an extra purchase neutral.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.independentTransferReason: Transfers supply reasoning to a freely invented unnecessary purchase and disposal choice. Both consumption and disposal need resource AND energy grounds; no actual household data are requested.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.rubricReason: Rubric checks resource addition, common useful basis/remaining energy, and both choice components with the neutrality counterclaim. Qualitative reasoning suffices; no forced LCA/calculation/plant-description duty.

completeCaseDesignDecisions.scientificAndSourceBoundedReason: R1/R2 return the same 0.8 kg plus 0.2 kg addition. R1 energy 30<55; R2 60>55. Resource conservation therefore survives the change while an energy saving does not; no universal route ranking follows.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.independentTransferReason: A different metal and extra supplied transport/treatment effort require separating two conservation claims and revising reasons for both the needed replacement/extra purchase and disposal options.
completeCaseDesignDecisions.rubricReason: Full criteria require both consumption/disposal and the R2 resource/energy conflict, with missing wider impacts acknowledged. Repeating a recycling slogan or process description cannot earn full credit.

finiteFindings.actualV1InstructionDe: Ändere dein Urteil anhand der neuen R-Information
finiteFindings.actualV1InstructionEn: Revise your judgment using the new R information
finiteFindings.ownReason: Part 2 explicitly allows a data-justified provisional choice of B. The new R-specific critical release under A may confirm that B choice. A literal demand to change the judgment can then penalize a coherent continuation; reconsidering the evidence is required, changing the selected option is not.
finiteFindings.requiredFiniteCorrection: Ask the learner to check the new R information and either confirm or adjust the reasoned first judgment. Preserve the requirement to incorporate that information and to limit transfer to R.
finiteFindings.rubricInterpretation: Full credit requires integration of the new release observation and the information limit. Its revision wording is read as reassessment/refinement of reasons and does not impose an A-to-B switch or a changed option when B was already justified. Partial credit penalizes omission of the new information, not the absence of a forced switch.

minimumDemonstrationInterpretation.meaning: Two distinct, independently reasoned evidence pieces, potentially inside one rich multi-step task. They may be original-condition reasoning and independently argued transfer to a changed material/boundary condition. Count evidence, not task labels.

dataOriginAssessment: All six designs transparently use idealized authored teaching-model data. They do not claim measured lab/learner results, external actual mine/plant facts or real local disposal instructions. Anonymous metals remain bounded examples; no mandatory real taxonomy or recall list is inferred.
safetyAndPrivacyAssessment: All six are paper/data tasks with no hazardous handling/opening/mining experiment. Personal decisions are freely invented; private household, learner state, session or credential data are not requested or included.
remainingGates: Resolve exact P-DESIGN-B-R01 by additive whole-case/whole-profile successor and bounded revalidation.
Root must materialize through the unchanged production positive builder only after actual final canonical/dependency/semantic-kind/source/page/resource inputs exist.
Current native P/D and M/V/context/visibility checks remain separate; reviewed design is not observed learner performance or mastery.
